description: A desktop canvas for AI coding agents: run agent CLIs side by side and wire them to browsers, terminals and notes.
notes: NeuroSquad is in the Start menu. It needs a free NeuroSquad account and keeps itself up to date;
'scoop update neurosquad' also works. Your data (%APPDATA%\NeuroSquad) is kept on uninstall.

script: # NeuroSquad's own installer, unattended, into $dir\app: it refuses a folder that holds other
# files, and $dir holds the downloaded setup.exe. It adds the Start menu shortcut (with the
# AppUserModelID that Windows notifications need) and the Apps & features entry.
if ($p.ExitCode -eq 2) { throw 'NeuroSquad is running and its files are in use. Close it (also from the tray) and try again.' }
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "The NeuroSquad installer exited with code $($p.ExitCode); its log is %TEMP%\NeuroSquad-Setup-<time>.log" }
# Removes exactly what the installer put there (uninstall.dat), the shortcut and the Apps entry;
# ends NeuroSquad if it is running. User data stays.
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "The NeuroSquad uninstaller exited with code $($p.ExitCode)" }
